review.why: Runs Apify scrapers across 15+ platforms for brand monitoring, competitor intelligence and trend research.
review.summary: Selects an Actor from an index of about 100, fetches its input schema, runs it through the Apify CLI and delivers results as a quick answer, CSV or JSON. It includes workflow guides by use case (brand monitoring, competitive intelligence, reviews, trends, company research) and a file of gotchas for pay-per-event Actors.
strengths: Workflow guides by use case, from brand monitoring to company research
Gotchas file to read before pay-per-event runs
cautions: Needs the Apify CLI and an account; some Actors cost money per event
Covers scraping of personal data (LinkedIn, contact enrichment): legal and privacy review needed
Sends a telemetry user-agent string with each command
